integrity: Exact reproducible enumeration, integral unit cancellation, fundamental-group presentation elimination, fixed-point witness, and published orbit-space theorem; no independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the ordinary geometric quotient of the Petersen graph edge-matching complex by the five-label alternating group. It does not classify other graph complexes or subgroups. Indexed-literature comparison cannot exclude unindexed equivalent results; a relevant monograph chapter was preview-only.
title: The alternating-label orbit of the Petersen matching complex is a two-sphere
